offers_price_currency_check.name: offers_price_currency_check
offers_price_currency_check.value: ("offers"."price_minor" is null) = ("offers"."currency" is null) and ("offers"."price_minor" is null or "offers"."price_minor" >= 0)

organizations_member_read.name: organizations_member_read
organizations_member_read.using:
exists (
        select 1 from organization_memberships
        where organization_memberships.organization_id = "organizations"."id"
          and organization_memberships.user_id = current_setting('vanguard.user_id', true)
      )

organizations_admin_update.name: organizations_admin_update
organizations_admin_update.using: "organizations"."id"::text = current_setting('vanguard.organization_id', true) and exists (select 1 from organization_memberships m where m.organization_id = "organizations"."id" and m.user_id = current_setting('vanguard.user_id', true) and m.role in ('owner', 'admin'))
organizations_admin_update.withCheck: "organizations"."id"::text = current_setting('vanguard.organization_id', true) and exists (select 1 from organization_memberships m where m.organization_id = "organizations"."id" and m.user_id = current_setting('vanguard.user_id', true) and m.role in ('owner', 'admin'))

workspaces_member_insert.name: workspaces_member_insert
workspaces_member_insert.withCheck: "workspaces"."organization_id"::text = current_setting('vanguard.organization_id', true) and exists (select 1 from organization_memberships m where m.organization_id = "workspaces"."organization_id" and m.user_id = current_setting('vanguard.user_id', true) and m.role in ('owner', 'admin'))
